title: Directed influence of the majority head coalition
statement: Let $k,m:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ and $t\in\mathbb{R}$. Suppose $m(q)\to\infty$ and $k(q)/\sqrt{k(q)+m(q)}\to t$. For majority on $k(q)+m(q)$ coordinates, the head coalition consisting of the first $k(q)$ coordinates has influence toward each of $+1$ and $-1$ converging to $\tfrac12-Q(t)$, where $Q(t)=\Pr(Z>t)$ for a standard normal random variable $Z$.
hypotheses_covered: the head coalition influence toward $+1$ has the stated limit
the head coalition influence toward $-1$ has the stated limit
